name: Indie Game Reviewer

sources.title: Homepage — active indie game review/news site (2026-dated reviews and Steam Next Fest coverage)
Contact IGR — 'Get Reviewed' submission rules, contact form, advertising and write-for-us info
Batch-provided URL — returns 404; real contact route is /contact-indie-game-reviewer/

requirements: Indie games only — this is an editorial review site, not a SaaS directory
Send a non-DRM download link or 2 redemption codes
Include a trailer link and brief game description
Full games only — no demos or alphas
Submission does not guarantee coverage — reviews are editorial pick
IGR does not accept money for reviews and publishes no sponsored content
preparation: Non-DRM build/download link or 2 redemption codes for the released game
Trailer link and a brief game description
The contact form asks for name, email, subject, message only — put the pitch in the message
A fit check: a SaaS productivity product has no route here; only playable indie games qualify
workflow: Fill the contact form with name, email, subject, and a pitch containing the game description, trailer link, and download link/codes
Submit and wait — coverage is editorial, no stated turnaround
If covered, expect a scored review under /category/reviews/ or a news/feature mention
watchFor: Batch URL /contact-ir is dead — use the full /contact-indie-game-reviewer/ path
IGR explicitly warns about impostors asking money to 'review on behalf of IGR' — legitimate contact comes only from the indiegamereviewer.com domain
No paid/sponsored coverage exists; do not offer payment
Non-game submissions will simply be ignored
countsAsLive: A review or feature article naming the game is published on indiegamereviewer.com (visible under Reviews/News or the archives)
unknowns: Whether the contact form is actively monitored versus email
Whether a followed link to the game's store page is included in reviews
